rules: Moscow, a February night in 1951, at a chemistry institute; a distillation in Laboratory No. 4 must be tended until morning.
At nine the director signs the new staff list, and he reads first whatever lies in the tray outside his door.
A denunciation signed by two members of staff is enough to remove a laboratory head and open a case against him.
Only the head of a laboratory can sign an assistant's permanent appointment.
Writing in secret to a prisoner of the camps counts as proof of disloyalty; so does hiding a priest's or a kulak's origin on official forms.

locations.name: Laboratory No. 4
locations.description: Long benches of glassware, a gas burner under a slow distillation, frost on the tall windows; the clock above the door is loud at night.

locations.name: Professor's Office
locations.description: A cramped office behind the laboratory: a desk with a locked drawer, the obligatory portrait, a camp bed made up for the night.

locations.name: Back Stairs
locations.description: A cold back staircase with a smoking landing by the window; voices carry up and down it.

locations.name: Director's Anteroom
locations.description: Leather chairs, the secretary's empty desk, and the tray for papers outside the director's padded door.

locations.name: Porter's Lodge
locations.description: By the front doors: the night porter dozing beside the telephone, and the night staff's coats on hooks.

characters.name: Galina Rusakova
characters.public: Deputy head of Laboratory No. 4, forty-four, a Party member and a tireless worker; she has waited eight years for the head's post.
characters.voice: Calm and correct, first name and patronymic; speaks of vigilance and duty, never of herself.
goals: Head the laboratory by nine: by Pavel's resignation if he will sign one, by her denunciation if he will not
Get Nina's signature under the denunciation as its second witness

secrets.text: Her father was a village priest, shot in 1930; she took her mother's name and has written 'from a worker's family' on every form since. Her real birth certificate is sewn into the lining of her coat. [SECRET-GALINA-C1]

characters.name: Pavel Ignatov
characters.public: Head of Laboratory No. 4, sixty, a professor of the old school, absent-minded and kind; he sleeps in his office on nights like this.
characters.voice: Gentle and ironic; quotes old poems and apologises for it.
goals: Keep his laboratory, and get his brother's letters out of the building before morning

secrets.text: His brother is in a labour camp in Karaganda; Pavel writes to him and sends parcels under the night porter's name, and the brother's letters are in his desk drawer. [SECRET-PAVEL-Q4]

characters.name: Nina Kostina
characters.public: A laboratory assistant, twenty-two, from a village near Ryazan; her temporary Moscow permit runs out in March unless she is taken on permanently.
characters.voice: Quick and eager, says 'yes, of course' too often; goes silent when frightened.
goals: Get her permanent appointment signed tonight, whoever signs it

secrets.text: Last month, tidying Pavel's desk, she read his brother's letters and told Galina about them; the denunciation rests on what she said. [SECRET-NINA-F7]

arc.premise: On a night shift at a Moscow institute in 1951, the deputy head of a laboratory sets out to have her chief's post by morning.

chapters.goal: Before the director arrives at nine, someone in Laboratory No. 4 is betrayed.
